name: xsmom
description: Cross-sectional momentum / BTC-residual momentum / CTREND-lite on the PIT top-30 perps, daily bars, weekly or 3-day rebalance, long top-k / short bottom-k beta-hedged (or long top-k vs BTC), vol-targeted to 20%.
mechanism: Winners keep winning (attention / under-reaction), losers keep losing (alt bleed, delistings); beta-hedged long-short across the PIT top-30 so BTC direction is removed. Counterparty: mean-reversion traders and dip buyers of dying alts.

wf.frozen_rule: most chosen across folds (2/7), ties by median train rank

null.kind: random longs/shorts from the same eligible set, same k/hedge/rebalance/vol target

implementability_200.note: missing = not listed on Bybit linear today (delisted or renamed, e.g. 1000SHIBUSDT is SHIB1000USDT on Bybit); those legs are simulated unrounded

caveats: Pre-committed kill criterion (research #7): net Sharpe < 0.5 over 2022-2025H1. Stitched WF OOS 2022-01..2025-06 Sharpe 0.37, CAGR 5.7%, maxDD -30.4% -> KILLED. Deflated Sharpe 0.04 (72 trials).

Closest thing to alive in family C: positive, ~0 correlation to BTC (0.03 OOS) and to BTC trend (0.04), null percentile 94 (p=0.07) vs random beta-hedged L/S books (null mean -0.37), PBO 0.16. OOS by year: 2022 -1%, 2023 -12%, 2024 +21%, 2025H1 +15%. The good half is the recent half.

Selection unstable: WF chose resid-mom, then 7d mom, then 30d mom, then CTREND (last two folds). FROZEN = CTREND-lite k=3 weekly ls_beta (most chosen, 2/7). Every ls_beta config is positive over the dev period (dev Sharpe 0.4-1.3); every long_btc config (long top-k vs BTC short) is ~0 or negative: the premium here sits on the SHORT side (losers keep losing), the opposite of the literature's long-leg claim.

Funding is income here (-3.4%/yr of equity 'paid' = received) and it is lumpy: TRBUSDT and BLZUSDT squeeze episodes in 2023 (longs paid by deeply negative funding) are ~$33 of the ~$49 funding income on the dev run. Do not count on it.
Worst single leg -90% on notional (a short squeezed); vol targeting keeps it survivable, but the short leg of illiquid losers is the tail risk.

$200 implementability: ~22% of intended order legs fall below Bybit minimums (mostly small re-sizing deltas); 13% of traded notional is in symbols not listed on Bybit today (delisted/renamed: 1000SHIB, MATIC, FTM...). Rounded-run Sharpe 0.46 vs 0.43 unrounded on 2022-2025H1 (noise).
Lab random-timing null (keeps each coin's holding runs, permutes timing) gives only the 66th pct: part of the P&L is WHICH coins are held short (persistent losers), not when.
Daily bars; rebalance decisions at the 00:00 UTC close (00:07 run); no intra-week stops modelled.

causality.walk_forward_guard: passed (walk_forward raises on a causality breach)

correlation.btc_trend_def: BTC 1x long when the prior daily close > SMA100, else flat, no costs

trade_stats_basis: stitched WF OOS, per-symbol round trips (a pair trade = 2)
